messages:
Nina: Escalating from Support -> CS. Trial org BlueSparrow is seeing repeated 502s for embeddings since ~04:05 PDT. Support restarted containers; errors persist. Need CS for customer comms and enablement prep.
Carlos: Acknowledged. Please paste the last-good time and a sample error.
Nina: Last known-good 04:03. Fail at 04:06. Sample log:
```ERROR embed-frontend: upstream 502 model=s-embed-1024 trace=tx-c3d2 err="kv cache timeout"```
Nina: Repro: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"s-embed-1024","input":"hello"}' -> 502 from prod-eu-central pool. INF-3321 opened.
ops-bot: [alert] embed-service 5xx spike (prod-eu-central) - 120 errors in last 5m.
Carlos: Riley, can you own ops mitigation? Tara, FYI on renewal posture - BlueSparrow is mid-trial and has a CSM check-in scheduled in 4 days.
Riley: On it. Ops play: 1) temp-route tenant to capacity-phi (fallback) 2) bump tenant KV TTL from 5s -> 25s 3) enable verbose traces for trace ids starting tx-c3d2* for 40m 4) monitor error rate and p50 on https://console.redwood.ai/dash/prod-eu-central
Nina: Support can switch routing; want CS ok to notify customer about a planned failover?
Tara: This is delicate. If time-to-fix >3h mark as renewal-watch. Offer one complimentary week of dedicated capacity if SLA impacted. Also prep a short SE intro in case they request deeper tuning.
Carlos: Draft customer ack (<30s read): "Hi BlueSparrow team 1; were aware of intermittent 502 errors affecting embeddings in your trial. Were routing your traffic to alternate capacity now and will update within 60 minutes. Well follow with an RCA and optional enablement session. Customer Success"
Nina: Love it. Riley, execute route-switch and post back with verification metrics.
Riley: Executed route to capacity-phi at 3055559885. Initial check: 16/18 requests OK, two transient 502s. Verbose traces enabled.
ops-bot: [incident-update] INF-3321 mitigation applied (route-switch) at 3055559885.
Tara: Carlos, please tag account in CRM as "renewal-watch" and create follow-up actions: postmortem, enablement call, credit review.
Carlos: Tagged. Also recommended play: if outage >6h propose a 10% credit toward next invoice and schedule an SE-led deep-dive before renewal.
Nina: Sent acknowledgement to BlueSparrow at 3055559892 (copied here).
Nina: Paste of sent message: "Hi BlueSparrow 4; were routing your embeddings traffic to alternate capacity to mitigate intermittent 502s. Expect an update within 1 hour. Apologies for the disruption; well share an RCA and offer an enablement session. Nina, Redwood Support"
Riley: Monitoring: error rate now 0.9% over last 12m. Keep verbose traces for 40m and verify 30 consecutive successful requests before closing. If error rate >5% escalate to runtime-eng.
Tara: Scheduling provisional 30-min enablement slot with SE for two business days before renewal. If customer accepts earlier, include CS+Support+SE. Agenda: 1) what happened 2) embed sizing & KV cache best practices 3) recommended prompt/limit guidance 4) Qs.
Carlos: Action items: Nina (customer comms), Riley (ops mitigation + logs), Tara (renewal play + schedule), Carlos (CRM + credits guidance).
Nina: Error rate trending down; current 0.6% last 10m. Will escalate if rises. Closing criteria: <0.5% for 30m.
Riley: Note: increased KV TTL may raise token cost slightly; include that in enablement materials as tradeoff.
Carlos: Will include cost/latency tradeoffs and a short checklist for the enablement session.
ops-bot: [status] INF-3321 monitored - mitigation active.
Tara: Thanks team. Ill follow up with meeting invite and draft RCA once metrics stable. Marking thread resolved when closure criteria met. :eyes:
